summary: This bill requires the Comptroller General to study and report to Congress on how Federal, State, local, and Tribal agencies use unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and counter-UAS technologies, including recommendations for improving legal authorities and manufacturing capabilities, and information on UAS deployment, origins, costs, usage, training, governance, privacy, and countermeasures.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the Comptroller General to conduct a study and submit a report, which would incur some administrative costs. However, this is a very minor expenditure in the context of overall government spending and is not the primary focus of the bill.
